utme_subjects: and any two (2) relevant subjects from Arts, Social Sciences or Sciences as specified by the institution

institution_waivers.note: Direct Entry: accepts Credit/merit pass in relevant ND/NCE or three 'A' Level in IJMB with minimum of 9 points.
UTME: requires 'O' Level credit passes in English Language and three (3) Social Sciences or Arts subjects plus at least 'O' Level pass in Mathematics.
UTME: requires Five credit passes at SSCE (or its equivalent) in English, Mathematics, Government/History and two other Arts or Social Sciences subjects.
UTME Subjects: requires Government or History plus two other Arts or Social Science.
